summary: Bush-backed kerb on a quiet bend; homes 18-20 m across the road.
reasons: Bush slope behind, no homes on this side

drivers.seclusion: South side is dense bush; nearest dwellings are across the road, about 18-20 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed through road; kerb meets bush edge, so room beside lane looks tight for a van.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the north side only; no campervans seen.

flags: Steep: about 5% grade here, 8% mean overall
Narrow lane, little room off the lane
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy from the south and west; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether the bush edge leaves room to pull in

best_section.where: Dennis Street, south kerb along the straight past the bend, backing onto bush
